verdict.rationale: A database service could plausibly ship in-product AI insights, such as a dashboard assistant, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no such feature. Native vector search and the MCP integration (which lets external agents run SQL) are developer building blocks and an external-agent pathway, not product-generated insights or suggestions, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
